get_config: get the HuggingFace or Mistral model config from a model name or path with auto-detection of config format
register_config_parser: register a customized config parser class for an unsupported model config format
get_pooling_config: get the pooling and normalize config from a sentence-transformers model repository
maybe_override_with_speculators: resolve model configuration when speculators are detected in the model config
try_get_generation_config: get the generation config from a model, falling back to deriving it from the model config
